name: eighty-file-rename
scenario: Rename a widely-used utility function across the codebase: update its definition and every one of its roughly 80 call sites across unrelated modules, with no behavior change and no design decision at any site.
signal_summary: High file count but every site applies the identical mechanical edit with no design decision and no dependency between sites.
expect_reason: Repetitive, uniform, mechanical edits with no cross-site dependency fit waves of batched work, not architectural phases.
